glosses.notes: The part of the road set aside for people to walk on.

examples.sentence: 父亲每次带孩子走到学校门口的人行道上，都会先让他停一下，看一看左右有没有车，再告诉他什么时候可以过去。
那段人行道前几天让雨水冲得不太平，所以老人晚上出来买东西的时候，总是一边慢慢走，一边低头看脚下。
店门前的人行道虽然不算太宽，但是一下班人就很多，所以母亲每次来接孩子，都先让他站在里面一点。

example_translations.translation: Whenever Father walks with the child onto the sidewalk at the school gate, he first makes him stop, look to both sides for cars, and then tells him when he can cross.
That stretch of sidewalk was made uneven by rainwater a few days ago, so when the older person goes out to buy things at night, he always walks slowly while looking down at his feet.

The sidewalk in front of the shop is not especially wide, but there are many people as soon as work ends, so every time Mother comes to pick up the child, she first has him stand a little farther inside.

glosses.notes: To keep bearing pain, pressure, or something unpleasant without escaping it.

examples.sentence: 父亲说，天气再热也不是最难忍受的，最难忍受的是人明明已经很累，却还得一直站着把后面的事做完。
孩子肚子不太舒服的时候，本来一直想忍受一下就算了，后来母亲一看他脸色不对，还是马上带他去了医院。
老师说，一个人真觉得委屈的时候，不要总想着先忍受过去，能说清楚的时候，还是应该早点把话说出来。

example_translations.translation: Father said that even extreme heat is not the hardest thing to endure; the hardest thing is when a person is obviously already tired and still has to keep standing there until the remaining work is finished.
When the child’s stomach was bothering him, he originally wanted to endure it and let it pass, but after Mother saw that his face looked wrong, she took him to the hospital right away.
The teacher said that when someone truly feels wronged, they should not always think about just enduring it first. If it can be explained clearly, they should speak up earlier.

glosses.notes: To admit that you were wrong or that you made a mistake.

examples.sentence: 父亲一直跟孩子说，做错了事以后早点认错，并不会让人看不起你，反而会让后面要补的事少很多。
那个学生原来还想解释很多，可是老师把前后的事一说清楚以后，他就安静下来认错了，后面也没有再顶嘴。
姐姐说，认错最难的常常不是开口那一下，而是后面真的按自己说过的话去改，不要过两天又忘了。

example_translations.translation: Father always tells the child that admitting a mistake early after doing something wrong does not make people look down on you; instead, it greatly reduces how much has to be fixed later.

That student had originally wanted to explain a lot, but after the teacher laid out the whole matter clearly from beginning to end, he quieted down, admitted his mistake, and did not talk back again afterward.
My sister says that the hardest part of admitting a mistake is often not the moment of speaking up, but really changing afterward in the way you promised instead of forgetting two days later.

glosses.notes: To reach a firm conclusion after looking at the situation.

examples.sentence: 医生没有只听孩子说肚子疼，就马上认定是老问题，而是先问他今天吃过什么，后面又有没有发烧。
母亲说，看见别人晚回家一次，不要急着认定他就是出了什么事，有时候只是路上比平时更堵一点。
老师把几份作业放在一起看了很久，才认定真正的问题不在孩子不会做，而在他一着急就把顺序写乱了。

example_translations.translation: The doctor did not immediately conclude that it was the old problem again just because the child said his stomach hurt. Instead, he first asked what he had eaten that day and whether he had also developed a fever.
Mother says that if someone comes home late once, you should not rush to conclude that something must have happened. Sometimes the road is simply more crowded than usual.

The teacher looked at several assignments together for a long time before determining that the real problem was not that the child could not do the work, but that he scrambled the order as soon as he got nervous.

glosses.notes: To approve of something or recognize it as acceptable, valid, or worthwhile.

examples.sentence: 负责人后来之所以认可这个办法，不是因为它听起来新，而是因为大家试过以后都觉得确实比以前省了很多时间。
孩子把自己的想法写出来给老师看，本来只是想问问行不行，没想到老师不但认可，还让他回去再多写一点。
父亲说，真正的认可不是别人当面夸你几句，而是后面真有事的时候，还是愿意把事交给你来做。

example_translations.translation: The person in charge later approved this method not because it sounded new, but because after everyone tried it, they all felt it really saved much more time than before.
The child wrote out his own idea for the teacher to see. He had only wanted to ask whether it was okay, but the teacher not only accepted it as valid, she also asked him to go back and write more.
Father says that real approval is not just someone praising you a few times to your face, but that when something truly comes up later, they are still willing to hand the work over to you.

glosses.notes: To feel that an idea, value, or person matches your own view.

examples.sentence: 父亲不一定每次都认同母亲的做法，但是只要事情真对孩子有好处，他后来还是会安静下来再认真想一想。
那个学生一直不太认同别人给他贴上的样子，所以老师后来没有再急着管他，而是先问他自己想成为什么样的人。
姐姐说，看一本书的时候要是一下就完全认同里面每一句话，反而可能说明自己还没有把问题真的想明白。

example_translations.translation: Father does not necessarily agree with Mother’s way of doing things every time, but as long as it is truly good for the child, he will still quiet down later and think it over carefully.

That student never really identified with the image other people kept putting on him, so the teacher later stopped rushing to control him and instead first asked what kind of person he himself wanted to become.
My sister says that if, while reading a book, you completely agree with every sentence at once, it may actually mean you have not really thought the issue through yet.

glosses.notes: This row focuses on becoming aware of something more clearly or understanding it in a deeper way.

examples.sentence: 父亲住院以后，才真正认知到自己以前总觉得小问题不用管，其实后面很可能会一点一点拖成大问题。
老师说，孩子只有先认知到自己哪一步没有想明白，后面来问问题的时候，才不会一直绕来绕去说不清楚。
很多人真到了一个人带孩子的时候，才会慢慢认知到家里那些看着很小的事，原来每天都要有人去做。

example_translations.translation: Only after Father was hospitalized did he truly become aware that he had always felt small problems did not need attention, when in fact they could slowly turn into much bigger ones.

The teacher said that only after the child first understands which step he has not thought through clearly will he stop circling around and explaining things unclearly when he comes to ask questions later.
Many people only slowly come to understand, once they are really caring for a child on their own, that those household tasks which look very small still need someone to do them every day.

glosses.notes: Used to say that a situation continues without changing.

examples.sentence: 雨虽然已经停了，可是门前那几个有水的地方仍旧没有干，所以孩子出门的时候，母亲还是先提醒他别跑太快。
父亲年轻时写下来的那几本旧笔记，现在放在柜子里仍旧有人看，因为里面记的很多办法到今天还真能用。
那家店换了新的牌子以后，门口看起来虽然亮了很多，可是老顾客走到那条街的时候，仍旧会先认出以前那个名字。

example_translations.translation: Although the rain has already stopped, those wet places in front of the door still have not dried, so when the child goes out, Mother still reminds him not to run too fast.
Those old notebooks Father wrote when he was young are still read by people now that they sit in the cabinet, because many of the methods recorded there truly still work today.
After that shop changed to a new sign, the entrance looked much brighter, but when old customers walk onto that street, they still recognize the old name first.

glosses.notes: Refers to what will happen later on from now.

examples.sentence: 父亲把这次的教训记得很清楚，说日后再有这样的事，先问明白再决定，不要一着急就自己先说不行。
老师让孩子把这次做错的地方记下来，不是为了让他难受，而是想让他日后再做的时候，能一下看出哪里最容易错。
姐姐后来搬出去住的时候，母亲只反复提醒了一句，就是日后不管多忙，也要记得按时吃饭，不要总拖到很晚。

example_translations.translation: Father remembers the lesson from this time very clearly and says that in the future, if something like this happens again, he will ask clearly before deciding instead of panicking and saying no on his own right away.

The teacher had the child write down where he made mistakes this time not to make him feel bad, but so that in the future, when he does it again, he can immediately see where he is most likely to go wrong.

When my sister later moved out to live on her own, Mother kept repeating only one reminder: no matter how busy things get in the future, she must remember to eat on time instead of always putting it off until very late.

glosses.notes: Refers to the recent past, usually several days earlier.

examples.sentence: 店里日前刚换了一批新的灯，所以父亲晚上去帮忙的时候，一进门就觉得里面比以前亮了很多，也更容易看清东西。
母亲日前已经把后面几天要用的东西先买好了，所以这次下大雨以后，家里人反而没有像以前那样一下乱起来。
老师说，日前交上来的那几份作业虽然看着差不多，可是真仔细一看，还是能看出谁是真的想明白了，谁只是照着写。

example_translations.translation: The shop replaced a batch of new lights a few days ago, so when Father went to help there at night, he felt as soon as he entered that the inside was much brighter than before and it was easier to see things clearly.
Mother had already bought the things needed for the next several days a few days ago, so after the heavy rain came this time, the family did not suddenly fall into confusion the way they used to.

The teacher said that although the assignments handed in a few days ago looked similar at first glance, if you looked carefully you could still tell who had really understood the work and who had only copied the pattern.

glosses.notes: Used for something that continues without stopping through both daytime and nighttime.

examples.sentence: 孩子发烧那几天，父亲日夜都在那边陪着他，连回家拿衣服的时候都不敢走太久，怕医生来了自己不在。
那段路最近一直在修，所以那边日夜都没有停过，晚上关了窗也还是能听见一点声音。
母亲说，真要把一个孩子带大，不是偶尔忙一下就够了，而是很多小事都得日夜记在心里，不能一下就忘。

example_translations.translation: During the days when the child had a fever, Father stayed there with him day and night. Even when he went home to get clothes, he did not dare stay away too long, afraid the doctor would come while he was absent.
That stretch of road has been under repair recently, so things there have not stopped day and night, and even after the windows are closed at night, some sound can still be heard.
Mother says that truly raising a child is not something you can manage just by getting busy once in a while. Many small things have to be kept in mind day and night and cannot simply be forgotten.

glosses.notes: Used when something is becoming more obvious, serious, or strong over time.

examples.sentence: 这几年那边的人越来越多，门口那条老路也日益不够用了，所以大家才一直希望后面能早点修一修。
孩子对外面的事日益好奇以后，母亲发现他每天问的话也比以前更多，而且一个比一个难回答。
老师说，这个班最近上课时说话的人日益多了，如果再不把原因找出来，后面只会更难让大家安静下来。

example_translations.translation: Over the past few years, more and more people have been living over there, and the old road at the entrance has become increasingly unable to handle it, which is why everyone keeps hoping it can be repaired soon.
After the child grew day by day more curious about things outside, Mother noticed that the things he asked each day became more numerous than before, and each one was harder to answer than the last.

The teacher said that recently the number of people talking during class in this group has been increasing, and if the reason is not found soon, it will only become harder to settle everyone down later.

glosses.notes: To combine different things so they work together naturally.

examples.sentence: 这家店后来把老做法和新的材料放在一起融合以后，来的客人反而更多了，因为大家都觉得味道新，可是又不太陌生。
老师说，这次活动最难的不是准备多少东西，而是让几个年级的人真的融合到一起，不要一开始就各站各的边。
姐姐搬到新地方住以后，用了很久才把原来的生活习惯和现在的工作时间慢慢融合起来，不然每天都会觉得很乱。

example_translations.translation: After this shop later blended the old method with new ingredients, even more customers came, because everyone felt the flavor was new without feeling too unfamiliar.

The teacher said that the hardest part of this activity was not preparing how many things, but truly getting people from several grade levels to merge together instead of splitting into separate sides from the start.
After moving to a new place, my sister needed a long time to gradually blend her old habits with her current work schedule; otherwise every day felt chaotic.

glosses.notes: To change from something solid into liquid because of heat.

examples.sentence: 太阳一出来，门口那一点雪就开始融化，孩子去叫父亲的时候，地上已经全是水了。
母亲把刚从外面买回来的东西放下以后，才发现天气很热，要是再晚一点，里面早就融化了。
太阳出来以后，那一点雪慢慢融化下来，落到下面的盆里，声音虽然轻，可是一直都没有停。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the sun came out, the little bit of snow by the door began to melt, and by the time the child went to call Father, the ground was already full of water.
After Mother set down the thing she had just bought outside, she realized the weather was very hot. If she had come back any later, it would already have melted inside.
After the sun came out, that little bit of snow slowly melted down and fell into the basin below. The sound was light, but it did not stop.

glosses.notes: How much a container, device, or space can hold.

examples.sentence: 这只水壶看起来不算大，可是容量比父亲原来用的那只多很多，所以他现在早上出去以前只要装一次水就够了。
老师说，孩子现在不是记不住，而是一天一下放进去太多东西，已经超过了他那时候能接住的容量。
那个地方的容量本来就有限，所以一到周末人多的时候，老板都会先让后面来的人在外面等一等。

example_translations.translation: This kettle does not look especially large, but its capacity is much greater than the one Father used before, so now he only needs to fill it once before going out in the morning.
The teacher said that the child is not unable to remember things right now. It is that too much is being put in all at once in a single day, beyond the capacity he can take in at that time.
The capacity of that place is limited to begin with, so when there are many people on weekends, the owner always asks the people who come later to wait outside for a while first.

glosses.notes: To become part of a new group, place, or atmosphere naturally.

examples.sentence: 孩子刚转来时一直不太说话，可是后来慢慢融入这个班以后，连以前最怕上的那节课，也敢先把手举起来了。
姐姐搬到那边工作以后，用了很久才融入新的生活，不是因为别人不好，而是很多小习惯一时真改不过来。
老师说，一个人要想真正融入大家，不是一直跟着笑就行，而是别人有事的时候，你也愿意站出来帮一把。

example_translations.translation: When the child had just transferred in, he hardly spoke, but after he slowly integrated into this class, he even dared to raise his hand first in the lesson he used to fear most.
After moving there for work, my sister needed a long time to fit into the new life, not because other people were unkind, but because many small habits truly could not be changed all at once.

The teacher said that if someone wants to truly integrate into the group, it is not enough just to keep laughing along; when others have a problem, you also need to be willing to step forward and help.

glosses.notes: Public respect or distinction gained through effort or achievement.

examples.sentence: 父亲说，这份荣誉当然重要，可是真正让他高兴的不是把名字挂出来，而是大家以后更愿意相信他们做的东西。
老师拿到那个荣誉以后，没有先说自己多不容易，而是把全班一起做过的事一件一件地重新提了一遍。
母亲一直提醒孩子，荣誉要是真到了手里，更要小心，不要一下就觉得自己什么都比别人做得好。

example_translations.translation: Father said that this honor is of course important, but what truly makes him happy is not having the name displayed, but that people are more willing afterward to trust what they make.
After receiving that honor, the teacher did not first speak about how difficult things had been for her, but instead mentioned again one by one the things the whole class had done together.
Mother keeps reminding the child that if honor really comes into your hands, you must be even more careful not to suddenly think that you do everything better than other people.

glosses.notes: Soft in touch, texture, or feel.

examples.sentence: 这条新被子晒过以后特别柔软，孩子晚上一钻进去就不想出来，连母亲叫他去洗脸都得多叫两次。
姐姐买那双鞋的时候，不是先看样子，而是先伸手按了按里面是不是够柔软，因为她知道自己要走很久的路。
父亲说，这家店做出来的面包外面虽然看着普通，可是里面一直都很柔软，所以孩子每次经过都想进去买一个。

example_translations.translation: After this new quilt had been aired out, it became especially soft, and once the child crawled inside at night, he did not want to come out, so Mother had to call him twice to wash his face.

When my sister bought those shoes, she did not first look at how they looked, but first pressed the inside with her hand to see whether it was soft enough, because she knew she would have to walk a long way.
Father says that although the bread from this shop looks ordinary on the outside, it is always very soft inside, so every time the child passes by, he wants to go in and buy one.

glosses.notes: To officially enter a country or region through border control.

examples.sentence: 姐姐第一次入境的时候，前面很多要求都看得很慢，所以父亲一直站在后面等她，怕她一着急就把东西放错地方。
老师说，孩子以后如果真要一个人出门，先把入境时要看的东西都记好，到时候才不会因为排队太久就乱了。
母亲日前刚听朋友讲过一次入境的过程，所以这次轮到自己去的时候，虽然还是有点紧张，可是心里已经有数多了。

example_translations.translation: The first time my sister entered a country, she read many of the requirements very slowly, so Father kept standing behind her and waiting, afraid that if she panicked she would put something in the wrong place.

The teacher said that if the child truly has to travel alone in the future, he should first remember all the things he needs to look at when entering a country, so that he does not become flustered just because the line is too long.

Mother had only recently heard a friend describe the whole process of entering a country, so when it was her own turn this time, she was still a little nervous, but she felt much more prepared inside.

glosses.notes: Can mean beginning to learn something or the basic introduction to it.

examples.sentence: 老师说，这门课看着难，其实真正入门以后，很多地方就没有一开始想得那么可怕，关键是先把最前面那几步走好。
父亲给孩子找书的时候，没有一下拿最厚的那本，而是先找了一本入门的小书，想让他先把意思看顺。
姐姐刚开始学做饭的时候，总觉得自己永远都学不会，后来才发现只要真的入门了，后面很多事都会一件一件接上来。

example_translations.translation: The teacher said that although this course looks difficult, once you truly get started, many parts are not as frightening as they seemed at first. The key is to handle the first few steps well.
When Father was choosing books for the child, he did not immediately take the thickest one, but first found a small introductory book because he wanted him to read the basic ideas smoothly first.

When my sister first started learning to cook, she always felt she would never learn it, but later discovered that once she had really learned the basics, many later things connected one after another.

glosses.notes: To be chosen from a larger group.

examples.sentence: 那个学生这次能入选，不是因为他说得最好，而是因为他前后准备得最细，连老师后面会问什么都提前想过了。
姐姐看见自己的名字入选以后，先没有说话，后来反而比以前更安静，因为她知道后面真正难的事才刚开始。
父亲说，能不能入选当然重要，可是更重要的是这次准备的过程会让你以后再做同样的事时，知道怎么准备。

example_translations.translation: That student was selected this time not because he spoke the best, but because he prepared most carefully from beginning to end and had even thought ahead about what the teacher might ask later.
When my sister saw that her name had been selected, she did not speak at first, and later actually became quieter than before, because she knew that the truly difficult part was only just beginning.

Father said that whether or not you are selected is of course important, but what matters even more is that this process of preparation will help you know how to prepare when you do something like this again later.

glosses.notes: A personal weakness or a point where something is easiest to fail.

examples.sentence: 老师说，每个人都有自己的弱点，真正重要的不是把它藏起来，而是先看清它什么时候最容易出来，再想办法改。
父亲后来修那台旧机器时才发现，原来它最大的弱点不是声音大，而是里面那块小地方一热就特别容易停。
姐姐说，自己最大的弱点不是不会做事，而是一着急就想一下把所有事都做好，结果反而更容易乱。

example_translations.translation: The teacher said that everyone has their own weaknesses. What truly matters is not hiding them, but first seeing clearly when they are most likely to appear and then thinking of a way to change them.
Only when Father later repaired that old machine did he discover that its biggest weak point was not how loud it was, but that the small part inside became especially easy to stop once it heated up.

My sister says that her biggest weakness is not that she cannot do things, but that as soon as she gets anxious she wants to do everything well at once, and that actually makes it easier for things to become chaotic.

glosses.notes: To scatter something in a light, loose way over a surface.

examples.sentence: 母亲怕门口太滑，天还没亮就先在那边撒了一点土，这样大家早上出来的时候，脚下就不容易一下打滑。
孩子帮父亲种花的时候，本来只想轻轻撒一点东西进去，可是一着急手就重了，后面只好又一点一点地往外拿。
姐姐做菜的时候常常先看一看锅里的样子，再看要不要撒一点东西进去，因为她知道家里两个老人现在不能吃得像以前那么重。

example_translations.translation: Mother was afraid the entrance would be too slippery, so before it was even light, she sprinkled a little dirt there so that when everyone came out in the morning, their feet would be less likely to slip.

When the child helped Father plant flowers, he had only meant to sprinkle in a little of the material, but as soon as he got nervous, his hand became too heavy, so afterward they had to take it back out little by little.

When my sister cooks, she often looks at what is in the pot first and then decides whether to sprinkle in a little more, because she knows the two older people at home cannot eat as heavily as before.

glosses.notes: This row focuses on pushing or stuffing something into a space.

examples.sentence: 孩子出门以前总爱把很多小东西一起往衣服里塞，结果真要用的时候，反而要找很久才找得到。
父亲看见车里已经没有多少地方了，就没有再让大家往里面塞，而是先把后面的东西重新放一下。
姐姐回家以后，一边说今天真的太忙，一边还把手里的纸和书往桌子下面乱塞，所以母亲一看就知道她又累了。

example_translations.translation: Before going out, the child always likes to stuff many little things into his clothes, and then when he really needs them, he ends up searching for a long time before finding them.
When Father saw that there was not much room left in the car, he stopped letting everyone squeeze things in and instead first rearranged the things in back.
After coming home, my sister kept saying how busy the day had been while also shoving the papers and books in her hand under the table, so Mother could tell at a glance that she was tired again.

glosses.notes: An organized competition or match event.

examples.sentence: 这场赛事虽然只有一个下午，可是父亲为了带孩子去看，前一天晚上就把后面的安排都问清楚了，怕到时候来不及。
老师说，看赛事的时候不要只看最后谁第一，前面那些人怎么一步一步做到那里，其实更值得慢慢看。
母亲原来以为孩子只是想去看热闹，可是那场赛事一结束，他却一路都在说自己以后也想像那些人一样认真练。

example_translations.translation: Although this competition event lasts only one afternoon, Father still asked clearly about all the later arrangements the night before so he could take the child to watch and would not run out of time.

The teacher said that when watching a sporting event, you should not look only at who finishes first in the end. How those people get there step by step beforehand is actually even more worth watching slowly.

Mother had originally thought the child only wanted to go and watch the excitement, but after the event ended, he spent the whole way back saying that he also wanted to train seriously like those people in the future.
